items.question: What arises when the hidden true nature of that is known?
premises: knowing hidden true nature precedes arising
items.inference: all-knowingness arises from knowing the hidden true nature
uncertainties: gender and number of gūḍhasadbhāvaṃ are inferred from surface form
items.plain_english: Knowing that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
